activities.description: Introduces the topic of negative ions, or anions.
Explains the formation of anions (gaining electrons).
Describes how to write anion symbols and charges.
Provides examples of anions from Groups V, VI, and VII on the Periodic Table.
Presents a table of common polyatomic anions and their formulas and charges.
